changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Registro inmutable de eventos de acceso (ARC-117): auditoria de login, bloqueo, logout y denegacion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE auditoria_acceso ( audit_id VARCHAR2(36 CHAR) DEFAULT ON NULL LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID()), '(.{8})(.{4})(.{4})(.{4})(.{12})', '\1-\2-\3-\4-\5')), user_id NUMBER, username_attempted VARCHAR2(150 CHAR), event_type VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) NOT NULL, operation VARCHAR2(100 CHAR), outcome VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) NOT NULL, occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT ON NULL SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, ip_address VARCHAR2(45 CHAR), user_agent VARCHAR2(255 CHAR), session_id VARCHAR2(36 CHAR), retention_until DATE GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(occurred_at + INTERVAL '24' MONTH AS DATE)) VIRTUAL, CONSTRAINT pk_auditoria_acceso PRIMARY KEY (audit_id), CONSTRAINT ck_auditoria_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ('login_ok','login_failed','account_locked','logout','permission_denied')), CONSTRAINT ck_auditoria_outcome CHECK (outcome IN ('OK','DENIED_401','DENIED_403')), CONSTRAINT ck_auditoria_user_nulo CHECK (user_id IS NOT NULL OR event_type = 'login_failed'), CONSTRAINT fk_auditoria_acceso_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Indices de la consulta de auditoria (REQ-061, AC-TRZ-03): filtrado por usuario y por rango de fechas
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_auditoria_user_occurred ON auditoria_acceso (user_id, occurred_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX ix_auditoria_event_occurred ON auditoria_acceso (event_type, occurred_at DESC)
